001package org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.harness;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
005import java.net.InetAddress;
006import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
007import java.util.Objects;
008import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
009import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
010import java.util.function.Consumer;
011
012import org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.common.telemetry.Telemetry;
013import org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.volume.http.TelemetryHandler;
014
015import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;
016
017import io.opentelemetry.api.OpenTelemetry;
018import io.opentelemetry.api.common.AttributeKey;
019import io.opentelemetry.api.common.Attributes;
020
021/**
022 * Runs code against an HTTP server that is up only while the code runs, in one trace: the code
023 * runs in a span, requests it sends through the {@link Server} are client spans that carry the
024 * trace to the server, and every request the server handles is a server span, a child of the
025 * client span that sent it.
026 *
027 * <pre>
028 * String body = Harness.inServer("Library", routes -&gt; routes.createContext("/", handler), server -&gt; {
029 *     return server.get("/books").body();
030 * });
031 * </pre>
032 *
033 * Like {@link Telemetry#inSpan(io.opentelemetry.api.trace.Tracer, String, Attributes, Telemetry.SpanBody)},
034 * with a server around the body. The server listens on the loopback address on a free port and
035 * handles requests on virtual threads; every context created on it is instrumented with
036 * {@link TelemetryHandler}. It is stopped when the body returns or throws.
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * The telemetry goes to the {@link OpenTelemetry} given, or the {@link Telemetry#current() current}
040 * one. With one instance for the client and the server, which is what running both in one JVM
041 * gives for free, the client's and the server's spans are in one trace and one recording.
042 */
043public final class Harness {
044
045        public static final AttributeKey<String> URL_FULL = AttributeKey.stringKey("url.full");
046
047        public static final AttributeKey<String> SERVER_ADDRESS = AttributeKey.stringKey("server.address");
048
049        public static final AttributeKey<Long> SERVER_PORT = AttributeKey.longKey("server.port");
050
051        private Harness() {
052                // Utility
053        }
054
055        /**
056         * Code to run while the server is up.
057         *
058         * @param <T> Result type
059         * @param <E> Exception type
060         */
061        @FunctionalInterface
062        public interface ServerBody<T, E extends Throwable> {
063
064                T run(Server server) throws E;
065
066        }
067
068        /**
069         * With the {@link Telemetry#current() current} OpenTelemetry.
070         */
071        public static <T, E extends Throwable> T inServer(String name, Consumer<? super HttpServer> routes, ServerBody<T, E> body) throws E {
072                return inServer(Telemetry.current(), name, routes, body);
073        }
074
075        /**
076         * Starts a server, configures it, runs the body in a span with the server's address as
077         * attributes, and stops the server.
078         *
079         * @param openTelemetry Receives the spans of the body, its requests and the server
080         * @param name Name of the span the body runs in
081         * @param routes Creates the server's contexts. Contexts are instrumented as they are created
082         * @param body Runs while the server is up
083         * @return What the body returns
084         */
085        public static <T, E extends Throwable> T inServer(
086                        OpenTelemetry openTelemetry,
087                        String name,
088                        Consumer<? super HttpServer> routes,
089                        ServerBody<T, E> body) throws E {
090
091                Objects.requireNonNull(openTelemetry, "openTelemetry");
092                HttpServer httpServer;
093                try {
094                        httpServer = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress(InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress(), 0), 0);
095                } catch (IOException e) {
096                        throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
097                }
098                try (ExecutorService executor = Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()) {
099                        httpServer.setExecutor(executor);
100                        routes.accept(new TracedHttpServer(httpServer, TelemetryHandler.filter(openTelemetry)));
101                        httpServer.start();
102                        try {
103                                HarnessServer server = new HarnessServer(httpServer, openTelemetry);
104                                Attributes attributes = Attributes.of(
105                                                URL_FULL, server.base().toString(),
106                                                SERVER_ADDRESS, server.base().getHost(),
107                                                SERVER_PORT, (long) server.port());
108                                return Telemetry.inSpan(Telemetry.tracer(openTelemetry), name, attributes, span -> {
109                                        server.span = span;
110                                        try {
111                                                return body.run(server);
112                                        } finally {
113                                                server.close();
114                                        }
115                                });
116                        } finally {
117                                httpServer.stop(0);
118                        }
119                }
120        }
121
122}
